code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Locate the full divider of color 2.
    horizontal=next((r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==2 for c in range(w))),None)
    if horizontal is not None:
        axis='h'; line=horizontal
    else:
        line=next((c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))),None)
        if line is None: return g
        axis='v'
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x!=2).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (2,bg)]
    if not pts: return g
    # Move the complete non-background object toward the divider until its
    # nearest edge is one cell away. Then mark the cell-line just behind it.
    if axis=='h':
        rs=[r for r,c in pts]
        if max(rs)<line: dr=line-1-max(rs)
        elif min(rs)>line: dr=line+1-min(rs)
        else: dr=0
        moved=[(r+dr,c) for r,c in pts]
        for r,c in pts: g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in moved: g[r][c]=grid[r-dr][c]
        newrs=[r for r,c in moved]
        mark=min(newrs)-1 if max(newrs)<line else max(newrs)+1
        if 0<=mark<h: g[mark]=[8]*w
    else:
        cs=[c for r,c in pts]
        if max(cs)<line: dc=line-1-max(cs)
        elif min(cs)>line: dc=line+1-min(cs)
        else: dc=0
        moved=[(r,c+dc) for r,c in pts]
        for r,c in pts: g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in moved: g[r][c]=grid[r][c-dc]
        newcs=[c for r,c in moved]
        mark=min(newcs)-1 if max(newcs)<line else max(newcs)+1
        if 0<=mark<w:
            for r in range(h): g[r][mark]=8
    return g
'''
